subject: Offer approval: Evan Cho (SDE2) — base/bonus/equity

Subject: Offer: Evan Cho — SDE2 (package proposal)

Hi Naomi,

We completed interviews for Evan Cho (SDE2) and the manager is ready to extend an offer. I wanted to run the proposed pay mix by you before we send. Key items below: 

- Base: $150,000
- Target bonus: 10% (performance)
- Equity: 10,000 RSUs, 4-year schedule (25/25/25/25) with standard one-year cliff
- Start: flexible Jan 2027 (preferred around 1/10)

I've attached the draft offer template and the comp-band chart for SDE2 (Q4 bands). The manager has verbally confirmed headcount and team budget. Can you confirm this package is within band and ok to send, or flag anything you want adjusted?

Attachments: Evan_Cho_offer_template_v1.pdf, comp-band-chart-q4-2026.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Hiring Manager, Platform Services

Date: 2026-11-10T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Offer: Evan Cho — SDE2 (package proposal)

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifying Qs before I sign off: 

1) Is the 10% bonus target tied to company OKRs or manager-level MBOs? I want to note the metric in the offer.
2) Are the RSUs 100% standard grant or is there any front-loaded portion in year 1? The comp-band sheet shows a median equity of 8k for this band.
3) Any signoff needed from finance beyond headcount confirmation?

If all standard, I can approve today. If you want to bump equity to match the manager's ask (10k), we should document the justification for audit.

-Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Offer: Evan Cho — SDE2 (package proposal)

Naomi — thanks for the questions. A few notes from comp/finance: 

- Bonus: 10% target tied to manager-level MBOs; company-level override only for exceptional stretch. We'll include language that target is 10% of base, payable annually based on performance.
- Equity: Manager requested 10k to align with candidate seniority and counter from another offer. We've pulled the comp-band: the midpoint for SDE2 is $140k base / ~8k RSUs. Given Evan's skils (distributed systems + strong Rust experience) and competing offer, comp is allowable as a one-off at the manager's justification. Please confirm Naomi for audit trail.
- Finance: headcount is covered under existing team budget; no additional finance approval required for this offer level.

I've attached the comp-band chart and the filled offer template (Evan_Cho_offer_template_v1.pdf, comp-band-chart-q4-2026.xlsx). Manager (Marissa) has confirmed willingness to sign the offer.

-Karthik

Marissa
